activity_summary: At home you said the line about Fame and the hole in the hose, and you stopped. You did not turn it into a speech, and you did not take it back out.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said the line once and did not add to it.

quotes.text: A king who opens his mouth on Fame had better not have a hole in his hose.
